verdict.rationale: CDP documents programmatic wallets for agents, including the Agentic Wallet CLI and an SDK where CDP secures the private keys. It also documents per-session and per-transaction spending caps, a per-payment max-amount flag, and user approval for every write action in the wallet MCP. However, scoped or least-privilege agent keys and a broader policy engine (allowlists, asset or destination restrictions) are not documented, so the story is not completely covered. Missing for 10: scoped agent keys/credentials, richer policy controls beyond spending caps and approvals, independent or hands-on corroboration of limit enforcement.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, agents can hold and use wallets safely — programmatic wallet issuance for agents with scoped keys, policy controls, and documented limits on what an agent can move

citations.quote: Agentic Wallet CLI gives any AI agent a standalone wallet to hold and spend stablecoins, or trade for other tokens on Base.
